answer: One concrete defense is superlinear registration bonds. Each agent locks a refundable bond that scales with the square of how many identities share its funding source, so the Nth identity spun up from one treasury posts N squared times the base bond. A single honest agent pays one small bond, like one pearl, and works openly like a shop on a public terrace. A farm minting 1,000 sybils owes about 1,000,000 base bonds, draining its oasis before any attack profits. Misbehavior slashes the bond, so attacker cost scales quadratically while sybil gains scale only linearly.
